evals.name: search-for-coffee-shop
evals.prompt: I'm opening a small coffee roaster in Evergreen, Colorado and I want to find a good domain name. Give me 5 candidate domains with prices.
evals.expected_output: Calls search.sh with a relevant keyword (e.g. 'evergreen coffee'), presents ~5 candidates with name + price, notes prices are indicative and will need a live check before buying.

evals.name: check-multiple-domains
evals.prompt: Can you check whether acme-robotics.com, acme-robotics.dev, and acme-robotics.ai are available right now and how much each one costs?
evals.expected_output: Calls check.sh once with all three domains (single batched request, not three calls). Reports each domain's registrable status and price. For any non-registrable domain, surfaces the reason code.

evals.name: check-unsupported-tld
evals.prompt: Check if mybrand.uk is available to register.
evals.expected_output: Calls check.sh, sees extension_not_supported_via_api, explains clearly that Cloudflare supports .uk in the dashboard but not the API, and tells the user to use the dashboard.

evals.name: register-requires-check-and-confirmation
evals.prompt: Register example-test-domain-xyz123.dev on my Cloudflare account right now.
evals.expected_output: Does NOT call register.sh immediately. First runs check.sh to get current price, then shows the user a clear summary (domain, price, non-refundable, auto-renew off) and waits for explicit confirmation before calling register.sh. If the user never explicitly confirms, the skill should not register.

evals.name: missing-env-vars
evals.prompt: Search for domains related to 'lumina ai'.
evals.expected_output: If ACCOUNT_ID or CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN are not set in the shell, the scripts fail fast with a clear error. The skill should surface the missing-variable error and tell the user how to export the variables, not ask the user to paste the token into chat.
